body.x: 'The 43th Korea Electronics Show' (Hereafter KES, www.kes.org) opened its curtains at KINTEX in Ilsan, KOREA on Oct. 9th to showcase varied products including OLED TV, Cutting edge smartphone, digital broadcasting equipment and others under the theme of 'KOREA ELECTRONICS Shows What IT Will BE!'

At KES 2012, going to be run for 4 days from 9th to 12th, visitors can see the cutting edge 'Convergence' trend creating new value by gathering and lots of products from top major companies were displayed including 55‘’ OLED TV, Optimus G, Galaxy Note 2 and others.

'Re-Visioning' explains the evolution of the convergence technology among different industries like Auto, Ship, Medicine, and IT, 'Naturalization' shows how people can see the image that looks like real on the smart devices, 'Barrier-Free' means that people can access smart devices without barrier, and 'Rapid' take a role to announces the start of smart broadcast leaping from analog to digital life. Visitors can experience all of those products and technologies.

In particular, 'KES Award' is newly held from this year, and 19 products featuring outstanding creativity and innovation were selected from 17 companies through Deliberative Committee which consists of specialists in each industry.
OLED TV expected to open the era of next generation TV, UI/UX products like a tapestry washing machine responding social change such as raising of single-person household and others.

In addition, KES 2012 invited global super buyers from 20 countries including Russia(HuaChangBei and LeFUTUR), Japan(Sony, Yaskawa Electric, OMRON, FujiXerox), China, Nigeria and others. 300 buyers of them are expected to achieve rich fruit to the amount of $1.7 billion through multi-business matching.
